dbVisuals R interface

This private source package launches the non-AI Canvas workspace and includes the separate mosaic_gl() linked R widget. It is not a CRAN release.

From the repository root:

remotes::install_local("r-package")
library(dbVisuals)
dashboard <- launchBrowser()                      # standalone DuckDB-WASM
# dashboard <- launchBrowser(db_path = "test.db") # native DuckDB
stop_sqlrooms(dashboard)

Native launch requires closing other writer connections to the database first. It authenticates the local frontend but does not sandbox authorized SQL. Standalone browser imports are not synchronized to R.

Use ?launchBrowser and ?mosaic_gl for their distinct interfaces. The repository README covers Canvas development; COMPATIBILITY.md records runtime and spec boundaries.
